verdicts.reason: The two share the same flawed layout. The symbol row is jammed against the top edge. The pink subcopy has a hard break that leaves 'CANNOT' alone on its own line. 'IT'S TIME FOR THEM TO BECOME REAL.' is crammed into a narrow column. The event details are shrunk to about 5 px and can't be read. In A that detail text is also squeezed horizontally ('MAY,14TH' is mashed together) and nearly touches 'BECOME REAL.'. B keeps normal letter spacing and leaves a small gap, so it is slightly less broken.
